# Temper Tantrums

> Temper Tantrums is a café and wine bar at 94 Wimpole Street, Marylebone, London W1G 0EH (opened 30 September 2026). Café by day — coffee, cornetti, breakfast bruschetta; wine & cocktail bar by night — serious wines, exceptional cocktails and Italian small plates with Asian accents (cicchetti, pinsa romana, salumi, matcha tiramisu). From the team behind the Temper restaurants. Brand voice: "irreverent elegance with a taste for mischief."

## Pages
- [Home](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/): overview, café by day / wine & cocktails by night
- [Menus](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/menu.html): full café, lunch cicchetti and dinner menus with prices
- [Private Hire & Events](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/events.html): venue hire enquiries for birthdays, launches and parties
- [The Space](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/space.html): the interior — chandeliers, collected mirrors, rock and roll portraits
- [Christmas Parties](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/christmas.html): Christmas party bookings and group takeovers for December 2026
- [Find Us](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/find-us.html): address, map and directions; near Bond Street and Oxford Circus stations

## Private hire
Temper Tantrums takes private parties, corporate events, birthdays, launches and full-venue takeovers, including Christmas parties. Enquiries via the form at https://tempertantrums.co.uk/events.html (capacities and minimum spends on request).

## Facts
- Address: 94 Wimpole Street, London W1G 0EH, United Kingdom
- Area: Marylebone, West London
- Instagram: @temper.tantrums.london
- Cuisine: Italian with Asian accents; notable dishes include pinsa romana, cicchetti, breakfast bruschetta, matcha tiramisu
- Opening hours: Mon-Fri 8am-11pm; Sat 8am-midnight; Sun 8am-8pm. Breakfast from 8am, lunch from 12pm, dinner from 5pm
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.com/r/temper-tantrums-london (OpenTable); walk-ins also welcome
- Price range: ££
